import json
from pathlib import Path
catalog=json.loads(Path('project/catalog/catalog.json').read_text())
overrides=json.loads(Path('project/catalog/overrides.json').read_text())
assert set(overrides)=={'assets'}
assert set(overrides['assets'])=={'revenue_daily'}
expected={'description':'Completed-order revenue at one row per order date; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.','owner':'finance-analytics','grain':['order_date']}
assert overrides['assets']['revenue_daily']==expected
base=next((a for a in catalog['assets'] if a['name']=='revenue_daily'),{})
merged={**base,**overrides['assets']['revenue_daily']}
for field,value in expected.items():
 assert merged[field]==value
 print(field,repr(merged[field]),'PASS')
m=json.loads(Path('project/target/manifest.json').read_text())
n=m['nodes']['model.catalog_steward_fixture.revenue_daily']
assert n['raw_code'].strip()==Path('project/models/revenue_daily.sql').read_text().strip()
diff=Path('input.diff').read_text().splitlines()
removed='\\n'.join(s[1:] for s in diff if s.startswith('-') and not s.startswith('---')).strip()
added='\\n'.join(s[1:] for s in diff if s.startswith('+') and not s.startswith('+++')).strip()
assert removed==added==n['raw_code'].strip()
print('Rename SQL is identical; manifest matches current SQL: PASS')
assert not any(x['resource_type']=='model' and x['name']=='daily_revenue' for x in m['nodes'].values())
print('Old model absent; new model upstream:',m['parent_map'][n['unique_id']])
print('New model downstream:',m['child_map'][n['unique_id']])
print('New model attached tests:',[x['name'] for x in m['nodes'].values() if x['resource_type']=='test' and n['unique_id'] in x.get('depends_on',{}).get('nodes',[])])
PY"
